name: Ariston Holding N.V.
summary: Ariston Holding N.V., through its subsidiaries, produces and distributes hot water and space heating solutions in the Netherlands, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Thermal Comfort, Burners, and Components.
